parsed.reason: The dates, time, link and child are all correct, and the message says plainly that Hale never registers for the parent. It fails on one rule: it ends with a question, 'Approuvez-vous ce plan ?', and an approval_card should ask nothing. Telling the parent to approve would be fine; asking is not. It also leaves the internal labels (week_ahead and so on) in the text, which reads stiffly.
